title: Rich in Mercy
story:
A young boy broke his neighbor’s window while playing cricket.

He froze in fear.

He thought he would be punished badly.

Slowly, he walked to the neighbor’s house.

His heart was beating fast.

When the door opened, he looked down.

“I am sorry,” he said quietly.

“I broke your window.”

The neighbor looked at the broken glass.

The boy expected anger.

But instead, the man sighed.

He smiled gently.

“I was young once too,” he said.

“Accidents happen.”

“I forgive you.”

The boy was shocked.

He did not expect mercy.

But he received it.

In life, we often fear punishment.

We think our mistakes define us.

We think God will turn away.

But God is compassionate.

Slow to anger.

Abounding in love.

He does not treat us as our sins deserve.

Instead, He offers mercy.

Every day.
life_lesson:
God is compassionate and full of mercy.

You are never beyond His forgiveness.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for Your mercy and compassion.

Thank You for not treating me as my sins deserve.

Help me to accept Your forgiveness.

Teach me to show mercy to others.

Fill my heart with Your love.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
Do you struggle to forgive yourself?

Do you believe God is truly merciful toward you?

Who can you show mercy to today?
verse:
The Lord is compassionate and gracious.
Slow to anger, abounding in love.
